svg.title: Plain Spark, Iceberg to Iceberg: per-row steps highlighted
svg.text: In Spark the data is columnar at both ends and rows in between

g.text: work done once per row
work done once per batch, per file or per job
Iceberg table lineitem: Parquet data files
Map stage · one task per file split
BatchScan · Iceberg vectorized reader
decodes Parquet into Arrow vectors on the JVM, 5,000 rows per batch
ColumnarToRow → Filter → Project · one generated Java loop
one row per loop iteration; the decimal multiply goes through java.math.BigDecimal
HashAggregate (partial)
per row: build the key as an UnsafeRow, hash it, probe the map,
update the buffer in place; the map lives in Tungsten memory pages
Exchange · BypassMergeSortShuffleWriter (200 partitions)
per row: partition id = Pmod(Murmur3Hash(l_orderkey), 200)
then length + UnsafeRow bytes into one lz4 stream per reducer
Shuffle files on local disk
one data file + one index file per map task; lz4-compressed row bytes
Reduce stage · one task per shuffle partition
Shuffle read
per record: fetch, decompress, hand out an UnsafeRow pointing into the buffer
HashAggregate (final)
per row: probe the map and merge the partial sum and count
AppendData · iceberg-java Parquet writer
per row: each value into its column's page buffer; pages encoded, zstd
Driver · Iceberg commit
adds the new data files to a new snapshot of the table
Iceberg table order_revenue: new data files
